title: 金门大桥 · 句子听写

sents.t: Every day, more than 110,000 automobiles cross a historic and beautiful bridge in northern California.
sents.zh: 每天有超过 11 万辆汽车驶过北加州一座历史悠久又美丽的大桥。

sents.t: It is named after the body of water below it.
sents.zh: 它是以桥下的那片水域命名的。

sents.t: The Golden Gate Strait connects the Pacific Ocean with San Francisco Bay.
sents.zh: 金门海峡把太平洋和旧金山湾连在一起。

sents.t: The distance between the main towers is almost 1,300 meters long.
sents.zh: 两座主塔之间的距离将近 1300 米。

sents.t: That was the longest suspension bridge span in the world for almost thirty years.
sents.zh: 近三十年里，这都是世界上跨度最长的悬索桥。

sents.t: Strauss used newly developed protective equipment for the men who worked on the bridge.
sents.zh: 施特劳斯为建桥工人使用了新研发的防护装备。

sents.t: It was chosen partly because it is easier to see through the heavy fog that often covers San Francisco.
sents.zh: 选它的部分原因是：在常常笼罩旧金山的浓雾里，这个颜色更容易看清。

sents.t: Many people walk across each year and there is no cost to do so.
sents.zh: 每年很多人步行过桥，而且这样做不花钱。

sents.t: On clear days, the bridge provides excellent views of San Francisco, ships down below and birds all around.
sents.zh: 天气晴朗时，在桥上能看到旧金山、桥下的船和四周的飞鸟，景色极好。
